issues.headline: 412 customers were debited by HDFC Bank and their orders are on hold
issues.cause: HDFC Bank took the money but has not told Razorpay the payment went through, so each payment stays pending and no order is confirmed.
issues.fix: Ask HDFC Bank to confirm or reverse the payments, and keep the orders on hold until it does.
signals: every payment has been pending since 9:12 pm
every one is an HDFC Bank account
other banks confirmed normally in the same minutes

groups.label: Order on hold
groups.hint: debited by HDFC Bank, not confirmed
groups.what: Debited, and the bank has not confirmed
groups.note: The order is on hold until the bank answers

groups.label: Paid again
groups.hint: if the first one is confirmed, charged twice
groups.what: Debited, then paid again another way
groups.note: Charged twice if the bank confirms the first

banner.title: HDFC Bank has not confirmed these payments
banner.text: Since 9:12 pm, payments from HDFC Bank accounts have stayed pending. The money left the customer's account, but the bank's confirmation never reached Razorpay, so no order was made. Razorpay and every other bank were working normally.

issues.cannot_see: customers whose bank debited them but who closed the app before the pending screen
issues.compared: Compared with the brand's payments in the same hours the day before

actions.title: Ask HDFC Bank to confirm
actions.text: Prepares the 412 payment IDs with amounts and times (₹5,63,088 in all) for the brand to send to HDFC Bank, to confirm or reverse.

actions.title: Ask the brand to keep 303 orders on hold
actions.text: ₹4,20,797 is waiting on the bank. The orders stay on hold and are released when the payments are confirmed.

actions.title: Message 412 customers
actions.text: Tells them the money has left their account, the order is on hold, and the bank has been asked to confirm. Written in the brand's name.

issues.closing: The cause was HDFC Bank, not the brand's app or Razorpay. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was sent to the bank, the brand or the customers.

issues.headline: 318 customers got two orders for one payment
issues.cause: The brand's server answered Razorpay's webhook after more than 5 seconds. Razorpay sent it again, and the server made a second order for the same payment.
issues.fix: Answer the webhook straight away and ignore a payment ID that already has an order. Cancel the duplicate orders.
signals: every one came after server release 3.14

groups.label: Duplicate not packed
groups.note: The second order has not been packed yet

groups.label: Duplicate packed
groups.note: The second order is already packed

banner.title: One payment is making two orders
banner.text: Since server release 3.14 went live at 6:05 pm, the brand's server takes too long to answer Razorpay's webhook. Razorpay retries it, and each retry makes another order. The customer was charged once.

issues.cannot_see: orders the brand made without a Razorpay payment, such as cash on delivery
issues.compared: Compared with the brand's payments in the same hours the day before

actions.title: Ask the brand to cancel 222 duplicate orders
actions.text: These 222 duplicates are not packed yet. The brand cancels the second order and keeps the first; the customer was charged once.

actions.title: Ask the brand to stop 96 packed duplicates
actions.text: These 96 are packed already. The list has order IDs and times, for the brand to stop before dispatch.

actions.title: Message 318 customers
actions.text: Tells them they were charged once, a second order was made by mistake and has been cancelled. Written in the brand's name.

issues.closing: The cause was the brand's server, not Razorpay: the webhook is sent again by design when it is not answered in time. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was cancelled or sent.

issues.headline: About 960 customers could not pay by card on the iPhone app
issues.cause: After the iOS app 8.3 update, the pay screen opens blank when the customer picks a card. Razorpay never sees an attempt, so these are counted from carts, not payments.
issues.fix: Roll the Razorpay SDK in app 8.3 back to the version in 8.2, or ship a patch, and invite the customers back.
signals: card checkouts opened blank from 11:20 am
every one is the iOS app, version 8.3
Android and web card payments were normal

groups.label: Paid another way
groups.what: Tapped Pay, then paid another way
groups.note: Bought, on UPI or net banking

banner.title: The pay screen is blank for cards on iPhone
banner.text: Since app 8.3 reached iPhones at 11:20 am, choosing a card opens an empty screen. No payment is made, so Razorpay has nothing to match. The count is estimated from carts that reached the pay screen and stopped.

issues.cannot_see: customers who left the app before they reached the pay screen
issues.compared: Compared with the brand's card checkouts in the same hours the day before

actions.title: Roll back the SDK in app 8.3
actions.text: Sends the brand the cause, the SDK version that broke the pay screen and the 8.2 version that worked.
actions.button: Send the cause to the brand

actions.title: Send the brand about 640 lost carts
actions.text: About ₹8,40,560 of carts were left. The list has cart IDs, values and times, for the brand to keep the carts open.

actions.title: Message about 640 customers
actions.text: Tells them card payments on the iPhone app had a fault and their cart is saved. Written in the brand's name.

issues.closing: The cause was the brand's app, not Razorpay or a bank. The count is an estimate from carts. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was sent.

issues.headline: 640 customers were charged the full price after using a coupon
issues.cause: The app applies the coupon to the order total but sends the full price to Razorpay, so the payment is larger than the order.
issues.fix: Send the discounted amount when the payment is created, and refund the difference.
signals: order and payment amounts differ from 8:30 pm
orders without a coupon matched their payments

groups.label: Percentage coupon
groups.hint: charged more than the order total
groups.note: A percentage coupon was applied to the order

groups.label: Flat coupon
groups.hint: charged more than the order total
groups.note: A flat-amount coupon was applied to the order

banner.title: Coupon orders are paid at the full price
banner.text: Since the coupon campaign opened at 8:30 pm, the order shows the discounted total but the customer's payment is the full price. Razorpay captured exactly what the app asked for.

issues.cannot_see: customers who saw the larger charge and cancelled the order
issues.compared: Compared with the brand's payments in the same hours the day before

actions.title: Refund the difference to 640 customers
actions.text: ₹1,12,005 in all goes back to the customers' original payment methods, each the gap between what they paid and their order total.

actions.title: Send the brand the mismatch list
actions.text: The list has 640 payment IDs, paid amounts and order totals, so the brand can find the coupon code path.

actions.title: Message 640 customers
actions.text: Tells them the discount was missed, the difference is being refunded, and when to expect it. Written in the brand's name.

issues.closing: The cause was the brand's app, not Razorpay or a bank. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was refunded or sent.
